name: Stash
description: Stash is a self-hosted media organizer for adult content, written in Go. It catalogs, tags and serves your collection with metadata scraping, previews and statistics via a web interface.

notes.text: First visit to the web interface runs Stash's setup wizard. Keep the default $HOME/.stash paths, which resolve to /opt/stash/.stash.
Mount your media into the container (e.g. `pct set <ctid> -mp0 /path/to/media,mp=/media`) and add it as a library path in the setup wizard.
Generated previews and sprites are stored inside the container and grow with your library. Increase the disk size for large collections.
GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding is offered during installation. Enable hardware acceleration afterwards in Settings → System → Transcoding.
